_comment: Resemble TTS voice catalog for AUTO-SELECTION. When TTS_PROVIDER=resemble, a Claude SDK call reads the narration content (genre, tone, emotional spine) + the vibe/use_for fields below and picks the best-fit voice_uuid. This is the FINAL shortlist (5 voices). Vibe wording for Arthur/Amelia/Nova was inferred (not heard) — adjust freely.

voices.name: CarlBishop_Convo
voices.use_for: analytical / explainer / steady neutral narrative; ALSO epic COSMIC & sci-fi scale (space, gods, world-enders, Power Cosmic) told with grand measured authority; the default when no strong tone dominates

voices.name: Rupert
voices.use_for: HORROR ONLY — vampires, monsters, supernatural dread, creepy/villain menace. Do NOT use for cosmic / sci-fi / superhero epics or non-horror tragedy.

voices.name: Arthur
voices.use_for: heartfelt / emotional / tragic male-led drama — betrayal, sacrifice, rage, redemption, bittersweet arcs (including tragic cosmic or superhero stories)

voices.name: Amelia
voices.use_for: tender / emotional / female-led stories; quiet sorrow, love, loss, character-driven drama

voices.name: Nova
voices.use_for: refined / poised female narration; measured literary or period storytelling, elegant restraint, dignified drama
